messages:
lina (People Ops): Quick question 12-night client engagement in Lisbon (May 314). Team booked a corporate short-term apartment (single invoice from host). Is reimbursement same as hotel? Do we still apply per diem? Any special receipt requirements?

jamal (Finance): We can reimburse. Need an itemized invoice showing nightly rate + cleaning/service fees and proof of payment. Accommodation reimbursed on actuals up to cap. Per diem is separate. :money_with_wings:

sasha (Travel Ops): Ops notes: if vendor bills Redwood directly via AP, employee should NOT claim the accommodation in Expensify/Concur. If the employee paid and was refunded later, submit with vendor invoice + bank/card proof. For apartments we also need guest name and property address on the invoice.

people-ops-bot: Policy excerpt: "Accommodation: itemized receipt required. Meals: per diem applies unless meals are included on lodging invoice; if included, per diem will be prorated."

miguel (Engineering): Our card declined, vendor invoiced the company. Anything I need to do besides adding the trip to Concur?

jamal (Finance): If AP paid vendor, Miguel, confirm vendor invoice number and dates in the Concur trip and set accommodation claim to $0. Attach the AP payment reference in trip notes.

lina (People Ops): Note on meal prorating: if vendor includes full board for certain days, per diem for those days is 0. If breakfast only, reduce per diem by 20%. I6l DM the exact prorate table. :thumbsup:

sasha (Travel Ops): Also flag VAT: EU invoices often show VAT. If invoice is to Redwood and AP paid, Finance handles VAT recovery. If employee paid, Jamal will advise on reclaiming VAT.

miguel (Engineering): Got the vendor invoice PDF and AP ref INV-2026-0453. I'll attach both and set accommodation $0.

jamal (Finance): Great. If invoice is lump-sum with no line items, ask vendor for a breakdown or an attestation email confirming nights + dates.

lina (People Ops): Action items: Miguel attach invoice + AP ref; Sasha confirm vendor attestation flow; Jamal confirm VAT handling. I'll update travel FAQ with this apartment scenario later today.
